functions.name: EFFECT
functions.description: Effect of a change: verdict, effect per period, 90% range low, 90% range high, effect in %.

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: The number you care about, oldest first (one column).

parameters.name: change_row
parameters.description: Row of the first period after the change, counted from the top of metric (1 = first).

parameters.name: comparisons
parameters.description: Optional: series the change could not have affected, same rows, one column each.

functions.name: WITHOUT
functions.description: What the metric would most likely have been without the change, for each period after it, with 90% low and high.

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: The number you care about, oldest first (one column).

parameters.name: change_row
parameters.description: Row of the first period after the change (1 = first value).
